text:
lucas: Heads up: the new Next + LlamaIndex sample (oss-starter) is firing duplicate embedding calls when using streaming on a hybrid page. Seen by anyone else?
nina: I noticed extra POST /v1/embeddings in CI e2e. Might be SSR + client hydration both running the same pipeline.
raj: Can you share minimal repro? Hybrid pages are tricky.
lucas: Repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/next-oss-starter branch: llama-wip. Steps: npm i, set REDWOOD_API_KEY, run dev, open /qa. On first render you get two embedding requests and LlamaIndex logs two index builds.
jenny: Paste of browser network and server stdout: 

```
Browser network:
POST /v1/embeddings 200 (payload id=E1)
POST /v1/embeddings 200 (payload id=E2)

Server log:
2025-02-15T09:12:01.123Z INFO llamaindex: building index job=xyz
2025-02-15T09:12:01.130Z DEBUG embeddings: req=E1 input=1
2025-02-15T09:12:01.260Z DEBUG embeddings: req=E2 input=1
```

lucas: E1/E2 have same input but different ids. Looks like both SSR and client call the sample's vectorize wrapper.
raj: Is the sample using Next's app router streaming / use server components? That can trigger partial streaming bits on client.
nina: It's using a hybrid page: server-side precompute + client streaming to show progressive results. We expected dedupe in the SDK but apparently JS SDK isn't deduping identical concurrent embed requests. Python SDK had a 'request coalescing' behavior historically.
jenny: Confirmed: Py SDK coalesces identical embedding requests while JS doesn't. That's a parity gap.
lucas: Short-term fix I pushed to the sample: add simple in-process dedupe layer in lib/embed.ts and document it. Patch: 

```ts
// lib/embed.ts
const inflight = new Map<string, Promise<any>>();
export async function embed(text){
  const k = text;
  if(inflight.has(k)) return inflight.get(k);
  const p = client.embeddings.create({input:text}).finally(()=> inflight.delete(k));
  inflight.set(k,p);
  return p;
}
```

lucas: That stops the double calls for identical payloads.
raj: Nice workaround. We should still fix SDK-side: single inflight coalesce for embeddings + cache key option. I'll open SDK issue.
olga: Can someone also add a Playwright test in the starter that asserts one embedding on initial full load? That'll catch regressions.
jenny: I'll add a tiny test in tests/playwright/ that spies network requests. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/next-oss-starter/pull/8
infra-bot: New issue created: SDK/PR-689 - JS SDK: add request coalescing for embeddings (https://tracker.redwood.ai/SDK-689) :sparkles:
nina: For DX docs, add a section on "Hybrid pages and embedding patterns" recommending either server-only indexing or client-only streaming + coalescing. Also call out SDK parity.
lucas: Added a README note in the sample and linked the SDK issue. Will revert sample hack once SDK fix lands.
raj: Assigning to @sdk-team. Please include unit tests and opt-in config flag (coalesce:true).
jenny: I'll land the Playwright test after CI flakiness checks.
olga: Thanks y'all. This really bit a customer demo earlier so good to have a test.
lucas: Closing loop for now. Will follow up on SDK issue. :pray:
